FN-TBPXR91-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 205
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/03/2026
Senate Bill 205 as introduced would: (1) extend the sunset date of the Underground Prevention
Program to January 1, 2037;(2) allow the Underground Damage Prevention Authority to
contract with a third-party administrator for administrative support instead of the Public Service
Commissary; (3) specifically authorize grants, assessments, and civil penalties to be deposited
into the existing Underground Damage Prevention Fund; and (4) allow excess monies in the
fund to be used for underground facility damage prevention.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 205
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/23/2026
Senate Bill 205 as passed the Senate would: (1) extend the sunset date of the Underground
Prevention Program to January 1, 2037; (2) allow the Underground Damage Prevention
Authority to contract with a third-party administrator for administrative support, instead of the
Public Service Commissary; (3) specifically authorize grants, assessments, and civil penalties to
be deposited into the existing Underground Damage Prevention Fund; and (4) allow excess
monies in the fund to be used for underground facility damage prevention.
